strip.empty: Captions will show here. Drag to move it, drag an edge to resize.

controls.label: Caption strip
controls.lock: Lock: the mouse goes through (unlock from the answer window)

settings.title: Caption strip
settings.intro: A see-through strip over the meeting that shows what is said, cut into short captions with the translation under each.

enabled.label: Show when a meeting starts
enabled.hint: The strip can always be switched on and off from the answer window's title bar.

bgOpacity.label: Backdrop
bgOpacity.hint: 0 leaves the strip fully see-through; the text keeps a dark outline.

fade.label: Fade out after
fade.hint: Seconds without anything new. 0 never fades.

locked.label: Locked
locked.hint: The mouse goes through the strip to the meeting underneath.

position.label: Place
position.hint: Drag the strip to move it and its edges to resize it. Reset puts it back at the bottom centre of the screen.

sample.olderSrc: Okay, let me give you some context on what we are dealing with.
sample.olderDst: 好，我先讲一下我们这边的情况。
sample.newestSrc: How would you redesign that, and where would you start
